projects.title: Quiet living
projects.description: A study in warmth, natural light and the pleasure of everyday living. Soft textures and considered objects create a space that feels personal, unhurried and at ease. These illustrative photographs demonstrate the portfolio layout; they are not Art Prime project photographs.

images.caption: Illustrative imagery · A softer palette for everyday life.

projects.title: Material dialogue
projects.description: Timber, stone and a quiet palette bring definition to open spaces. This interior study explores the balance between architectural clarity and the softer details that make a room feel welcoming. These photographs are illustrative, not completed Art Prime work.

images.caption: Illustrative imagery · A conversation between texture and form.

images.caption: Illustrative imagery · Natural materials, considered details.

images.alt: Calm grey bathroom with a freestanding bath and a long horizontal window
images.caption: Illustrative imagery · A moment of quiet.

projects.title: Gathered spaces
projects.description: Rooms are made to be lived in. This study brings together generous seating, familiar materials and a few expressive pieces to explore the art of gathering. The images are examples used to preview the portfolio experience, not Art Prime project photographs.

images.caption: Illustrative imagery · Space to come together.

images.caption: Illustrative imagery · Objects that belong together.
